summary: More community.hrobot deprecations: storagebox_snapshot_plan(_info) plans[].month only returns null, storagebox_subaccount password_mode=set-to-random is deprecated (legacy API only), and several subaccount return values are renamed for the new Hetzner API.
questions: Why is password_mode=set-to-random deprecated in storagebox_subaccount?
What happened to plans[].month in storagebox_snapshot_plan?
Which storagebox_subaccount return values are deprecated?
